linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit distribution
  • Processor: 1.7GHz, Quad-Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3 supported device
  • Storage: 260 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: To force OpenGL mode, input into Steam Launch Options: "--rendering-driver opengl3"
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS, Bazzite
  • Processor: 2.4GHz, Quad-Core CPU or better
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.3 supported device
  • Additional Notes: Runs flawlessly on Steam Deck.
